title: AI Parlance — AI-first IR for software generation
description: Write compact .aip specs. The reference toolchain parses, validates, and emits PostgreSQL, MySQL, OpenAPI, TypeScript, Go, and more. Clone the repo, run aip emit, less boilerplate.

hero.title: Intent first.
hero.subtitle: AI Parlance is an AI-first intermediate representation. Humans and LLMs write .aip; official emitters turn validated specs into SQL, OpenAPI, TypeScript, Go, and the rest of the matrix.
hero.note: Reference CLI in the monorepo: aip parse · validate · emit sql|openapi|typescript|go|mysql|…. Site playground below is illustrative only.

items.title: Smaller AI context
items.body: Edit ~10 lines of .aip instead of hundreds of framework boilerplate per entity.

items.title: Multi-target from one spec
items.body: One validated AST feeds PostgreSQL, MySQL, OpenAPI, TypeScript, Go, and more Preview targets.

items.title: Built-in domain blocks
items.body: Entities, CRUD, policies, workflows, and events in one predictable structure.

items.title: Validate before generate
items.body: aip validate checks full v0.1 tiers; aip emit produces Preview artifacts you can review before shipping.

items.title: LLM-friendly grammar
items.body: Controlled syntax helps agents produce consistent specs, not drifting code.

items.title: Honest scope
items.body: Focused on data-oriented APIs and automation — not custom UI or heavy algorithms.

toolchain.title: Official Preview emitters
toolchain.subtitle: Ten reference emitters from a shared AST. PostgreSQL was first; the matrix followed.

items.name: PostgreSQL
items.body: DDL, indexes, seeds. aip emit sql

items.name: OpenAPI 3
items.body: Schemas + CRUD paths (+ auth). aip emit openapi

items.name: TypeScript
items.body: Interfaces, guards, path helpers. aip emit typescript

items.name: Go
items.body: Structs, net/http stubs, auth. aip emit go

items.name: MySQL
items.body: DDL for database mysql. aip emit mysql

items.name: Workers
items.body: Jobs and queues stubs. aip emit workers

items.name: Docs
items.body: Markdown API reference. aip emit docs

playground.title: Illustrative demo
playground.subtitle: Quick in-browser preview. For the official toolchain, clone the repo and use aip emit.
playground.disclaimer: Not the official emitters. Official path: npm ci && npm run build, then node packages/cli/dist/cli.js emit sql|openapi|typescript|go|mysql examples/…
playground.errorParse: Could not parse spec. Check entity and crud blocks.

cta.title: Try the reference toolchain
cta.body: Clone the repo, run the test suite, and emit from examples/minimal.aip or the blog CRUD walkthrough.

emittersPage.title: AI Parlance — Emitters
emittersPage.description: Official AI Parlance Preview emitters across the transpiler matrix.
emittersPage.heading: Official emitters
emittersPage.lead: The reference toolchain turns validated .aip into concrete artifacts. Ten Preview targets share one AST.

sections.title: PostgreSQL DDL
sections.body: Tables, FKs, enums, soft delete, indexes, and seeds. Primary SQL target in the docs.

sections.title: OpenAPI 3
sections.body: Entity / Create / Update schemas and CRUD paths. Optional security schemes from app.auth.

sections.title: TypeScript
sections.body: Interfaces plus zero-dependency type guards and thin path helpers.

sections.title: Go
sections.body: Structs, thin net/http CRUD stubs, and AuthMiddleware from app.auth.

sections.title: MySQL DDL
sections.body: MySQL dialect DDL for specs with database mysql (see examples/mysql-minimal.aip).

sections.title: Workers
sections.body: Job and queue stubs from Behavior blocks.

sections.title: Docs
sections.body: Markdown API reference from the spec.

emittersPage.tryBody: Clone, install, build, then emit from examples/minimal.aip or examples/blog-crud.aip.
